title: I made a game with Claude and I'm trying to make money from it. Day 1
author: SadExpert8864
selftext:
Let me be honest right away: I'm a complete zero in game dev, and in programming too, but I have a subscription, so that's basically all. 

# How it started

I opened Claude Code and wrote something like: “Make an addictive game so it can make money. Do market research. I don't know how to do anything, don't ask questions, just make it.”

Then the agent did everything itself:

1. looked at web platform trends and chose a physics merge game in the spirit of the watermelon game;
2. wrote the game in pure JavaScript — physics, UI, saves, ads, purchases;
3. drew all the graphics in code — fruits with little faces, 5 skins, covers;
4. synthesized the sounds and music also in code, without audio files;
5. translated the game into Russian, English, and Turkish.

# What's the game?

https://i.redd.it/dpljzvp0s9vh1.gif

You throw fruits into a jar, two identical ones merge into the next one: cherry → strawberry → grape → … → watermelon. Two watermelons cause an explosion and a big bonus. If fruits stay above the line for too long, the game ends.

On top of that, there's meta to make you want to come back: combos for merge chains, three boosters (hammer, upgrade, shake), skins (candy, space, gems, cats), daily rewards, and daily quests.

# Where did I post it?

The agent found a platform itself, gathered developer reviews about it, and chose Playgama, because they distribute games through their partner network, pay 70–90% of revenue, and accept developers from Russia.

The game is currently in their sandbox. It's available via the link, ads are running in it, and Playgama gave a free initial traffic boost. To get into the main catalog, you need to reach 100 players with an average playtime of 5 minutes.

# Day 1 numbers

— spent: $20 on the subscription

— players: 0

— earned: $0 

# What's next?

I'll keep a diary — how many people came, how much ads brought in, what I had to fix, and whether the game made it into the catalog. Let's see whether AI can make something from scratch that brings in money, or if it's all just hot air from get-rich-quick gurus.

You can play it here: [https://playgama.ai/play/6i2t2aec5k](https://playgama.ai/play/6i2t2aec5k)
